correctness.rationale: For each i,j, max_{T}X_ij=min(r_i,c_j) by concentrating the smaller margin in that cell and assigning the remaining nonnegative margins by an outer-product fill. Inclusion K−A⊆−s(K−A) is equivalent, since the margin equalities persist, to (s+1)A_ij>=U_ij for all cells. A feasible lower bound exists iff each residual row/column margin is nonnegative, because totals match and a nonnegative rank-one residual fill exists; the minimum b=s+1 is beta. All optimal A are U/beta plus exactly T(R,C). Restricting to positive residual support, the classical rank of transport constraints gives (|I|−1)(|J|−1); S=0 gives a singleton. Monotonicity of sum_j min(1,c_j/x) proves the min-margin reduction. In square case beta<=n and a row or column with smallest global margin attains n. Checked 57 independent exact-rational constructions and LP comparisons (701 individual coordinate maximizations) including zero-residual and nonunique cases. No finite test is presented as a proof over arbitrary real margins.

Lemma 2.3 gives its dimension on the positive residual support, and the square beta=n follows from any minimum row or minimum column margin and the trivial bound beta<=n. Every asserted item thus follows through a short, explicit corollary chain of prior results; no unproved comparison remains.

originality.rationale: The complete claimed classification is already an elementary specialization of Belloni–Freund (2008), equation (40), or den Hertog–Pauphilet–Soali (2023), Proposition 4, combined with standard transportation feasibility and dimension theorems in De Loera–Kim (2013), Lemmas 2.2–2.3. These prior statements imply, not merely algorithmically touch, the exact threshold, full center locus, uniqueness/dimension and square case. The short cell-maximum identity U_ij=min(r_i,c_j) and minimum-margin monotonicity are straightforward. This is decisive prior mathematical coverage under the corollary rule, not a negative search shortcut.
residual_risks: No single inspected earlier publication explicitly prints the specialized beta formula; the FAIL conclusion is based on decisive short mathematical implication of published exact general symmetry and classical transportation feasibility, not a claimed verbatim prior identity.

Unlike a tiny arbitrary numerical slice, this is a coherent infinite natural-class classification; the margin-uniform square coefficient is a useful summary. Although its implication by prior general formulas defeats O, the object and exact invariant are mathematically motivated; do not confuse coveredness with intrinsic utility.
